notes.content: Physics Requirement: Students must select 8 units: PHYS 202A and PHYS 202B or Students must select two of the following courses: PHYS 204A , PHYS 204B , PHYS 204C (exception - see recommendation below). Physics Recommendation: Students who are considering attending graduate school should consult with an advisor before selecting lower division core courses. We recommend PHYS 204A , PHYS 204B , and PHYS 204C or their articulated transfer equivalents.
notes.contentHtml:
Physics Requirement:

  • Students must select 8 units: PHYS 202A and PHYS 202B or
  • Students must select two of the following courses: PHYS 204A, PHYS 204B, PHYS 204C (exception - see recommendation below).


Physics Recommendation:

  • Students who are considering attending graduate school should consult with an advisor before selecting lower division core courses.
  • We recommend PHYS 204A, PHYS 204B, and PHYS 204C or their articulated transfer equivalents.
